_help: Merged on top of ferratas.json. sites.<id>: fields replace scraped ones; routes merge by id (new ids are added). Unknown site id = new site (give all fields). remove: site ids to drop. Setting coords marks them verified. See README.

routes._note: approximate: source has no GPS, says it starts under the cliff just after Spirala Mica (see via-ferrata.ro route map)

pericolul-caprelor._note: The page describes 2 routes joining ~25 m up: left B/C with a 'Vietnamese bridge', right also B/C. Existing route id kept as the left variant so earlier completions stay valid.
